Citizens referred to their city-state as `` His Majesty ( or Sovereign ) Lord Novgorod the Great '' ( Gosudař Gospodin Velikij Novgorod ) , or more often as `` Lord Novgorod the Great '' ( Gospodin Velikij Novgorod ) .
